`solve_model` still takes callback snapshots from `n.snapshots`, not the model’s stored snapshot parameter. Its conversion only flattens snapshots for a flat model; it cannot restore a MultiIndex if the network’s snapshots were changed to a single-level index after building a MultiIndex model. Thus, a call to `solve_model` after such a change passes snapshots in a different representation from the model’s.
